answer.label: Not Albert Einstein — actually Darryl Anka, channeling ‘Bashar’
answer.sourceLine: This is a New Age channeling passage, not physics. Quote Investigator found the earliest version on bashar.org (page “The Ides of March,” archived 8 April 2000, copyright Darryl Anka 1996), where the words are credited to Anka’s claimed extraterrestrial entity “Bashar” — not to Einstein. It appears in none of Einstein’s writings and is absent from The Ultimate Quotable Einstein.

source.heading: Where it really comes from
source.excerpt: Everything is energy and that’s all there is to it. Match the frequency of the reality you want and you cannot help but get that reality. It can be no other way. This is not philosophy. This is physics.
trail: Quote Investigator concludes there is “no substantive evidence” Einstein said this and traces it to Darryl Anka’s “Bashar” channeling.
The earliest known copy is an Internet Archive capture of bashar.org from 8 April 2000, carrying a 1996 copyright in Darryl Anka’s name.
The line does not appear in Alice Calaprice’s The Ultimate Quotable Einstein, the standard reference for verifying Einstein quotations.
Anka, a Hollywood visual-effects artist, has publicly channeled “Bashar” since 1983; see his official bio.
source.cutTag: The words are Darryl Anka’s, not Einstein’s
source.excerptNote: The Einstein-labeled version circulating online. The 1996 Bashar original is essentially identical but lacks the added sentence “This is not philosophy.”
source.rightsNote: The wording originates in Darryl Anka’s “Bashar” material, published 1996 — well after 1931 and by an identifiable living author — so it is in copyright, held by Anka/Bashar Communications. It is in no sense an Einstein text and is not public domain.

author.name: Darryl Anka
author.heading: Who actually wrote it
author.metaLine: b. 1951, Ottawa · American–Canadian channeler & visual-effects artist
author.bio: Darryl Anka is a Hollywood visual-effects artist (credits include Star Trek: The Motion Picture) who since 1983 has publicly “channeled” an entity he calls Bashar, described as an extraterrestrial from the future. The “everything is energy” passage comes from this New Age material, copyrighted in his name in 1996 — long before anyone pinned it on Einstein.

misattribution.heading: How Einstein got the credit
misattribution.intro: A New Age channeling line acquired a physicist’s name because the passage ends with the word “physics” — and Einstein is the internet’s default authority for anything that sounds scientific and profound.

items.why: Quote Investigator found no substantive evidence Einstein ever said it, and it is absent from The Ultimate Quotable Einstein. The earliest copies credit Darryl Anka, not Einstein.

items.scope: The added sentence “This is not philosophy.”
items.why: The 1996 Bashar original reads “…It can be no other way. This is physics.” The extra sentence “This is not philosophy” was inserted as the meme spread, per Quote Investigator.

misattribution.truthLine: The words are Darryl Anka’s “Bashar” channeling from 1996, not Einstein — and they describe no known physics, as Quote Investigator documents.

context.heading: Why the credit stuck
lead: The line fuses two things people badly want to be compatible: hard science and the “law of attraction.” Ending on “This is physics” invites the reader to treat wishful thinking as a law of nature — and slapping Einstein’s name on top completes the illusion of authority.

In reality the passage is textbook New Age metaphysics from Darryl Anka’s Bashar sessions. “Matching frequencies” to summon a chosen reality is not a statement any physicist would recognize; energy and frequency in physics don’t work that way.
context.pull: It ends with “This is physics” — which is exactly why it isn’t Einstein’s, and isn’t physics.
